description: This file defines a React component 'TestResultView' and related helper components/functions for rendering detailed test results, including images, traces, errors, and test steps within a testing report UI.

classes.name: ImageDiffWithAnchors
classes.description: Extends ImageDiff with an array of anchor strings for linking purposes.

classes.name: StepTreeItem
classes.description: React component for rendering a test step and its nested sub-steps with status icons and attachments.

methods.name: groupImageDiffs
methods.description: Groups image attachments into diffs with expected, actual, previous, and diff images, filtering incomplete diffs.

methods.name: pickDiffForError
methods.description: Selects an image diff related to an error message if the error pertains to screenshot matching.

methods.name: buildWorkerLists
methods.description: Builds a map of worker indices to their associated test cases and run sequences from the report data.
